subject: Multi-region train-the-trainer: slot rotation & handover plan

From: Leo Tan <leo@paywave.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: train-the-trainer for EU/APAC pilots

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team at PayWave wants a focused train-the-trainer series so our regional leads can run internal sessions after go-live. We have two constraints: the EU product team prefers mornings CET, and APAC ops need late-morning SGT slots.

Can Redwood run two 90-minute sessions next week (one CET-friendly, one SGT-friendly) and include a separate 45-minute handover for our engineering enablement lead? Ideally sessions cover:
- Console admin + RBAC walkthrough (30m)
- API enablement + example integrations (40m)
- Troubleshooting & runbook review (20m)

We also want a short recording and the slide deck shared. Nisha and I are coordinating availability — attaching an initial agenda.

Thanks — Leo

Hi Leo / Nisha — great, glad this is moving forward. Camila and I can run the sessions. Quick proposal:
- EU session (CET mornings): Thu 3 Dec 09:30–11:00 CET
- APAC session (SGT late morning): Mon 7 Dec 10:30–12:00 SGT
- Handover (45m, recorded): Tue 8 Dec 08:00–08:45 PST (will be 16:00 CET / 00:45 SGT — we can shift if that’s inconvenient)

Camila will lead the API portion; I’ll do console/admin + runbook. Tessa can jump in for recording and follow-up artifacts. Can you confirm attendees and whether you need workspace access provisioned ahead of time? I’ve attached a short checklist for access.

Next steps: confirm times and attendee list; if dates work we’ll send invites/Zoom links and a revised agenda.

— Hannah
